AXIOM_0_1_DECIMAL_ONLY.name: Strict Decimal Financial Arithmetic
AXIOM_0_1_DECIMAL_ONLY.description: Never use IEEE-754 floating-point math for balances, order amounts, entry/exit prices, PnL, fees, or strike differences. All monetary math must use Python decimal.Decimal and TypeScript decimal.js.

AXIOM_0_2_UNCROSSED_BOOK.name: Uncrossed Order Book Invariant
AXIOM_0_2_UNCROSSED_BOOK.description: Best YES Bid + Best NO Bid <= 1.00 must hold at all times. Any crossed book state must trigger an immediate snapshot resync.

AXIOM_0_3_EXPIRATION_SINGULARITY.name: Settlement Boundary Continuity
AXIOM_0_3_EXPIRATION_SINGULARITY.description: At T_rem -> 0, mathematical formulas must not divide by remaining time. Settlement payout resolves strictly to $1.00 or $0.00 without floating drift.

AXIOM_0_4_PAYOUT_BOUNDS.name: Binary Contract Boundedness
AXIOM_0_4_PAYOUT_BOUNDS.description: Contract settlement values, option pricing, and probability estimates are strictly bounded in the closed interval [0.00, 1.00].

AXIOM_1_1_CFTC_ANTI_WASH.name: Zero Opposing Cannibalism
AXIOM_1_1_CFTC_ANTI_WASH.description: Multiple bots on the same account must NEVER hold opposing positions (YES vs NO) on the same contract cycle. Synchronously arbitrated by LiveCoordinator.

AXIOM_1_2_IN_FLIGHT_INTENT_LOCK.name: 1-Trade-Per-Cycle Intent Lock
AXIOM_1_2_IN_FLIGHT_INTENT_LOCK.description: Once an automated bot reserves trade intent for the active cycle, no further orders or additions may be submitted for that ticker until settlement.

AXIOM_1_3_MICRO_BANKROLL_ARMOR.name: Micro-Bankroll Hard Sizing Cap
AXIOM_1_3_MICRO_BANKROLL_ARMOR.description: For bankrolls under $75, sizing is strictly hard-capped to 1 contract per trade for each asset (BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE).

AXIOM_2_1_LIVE_SANCTUARY_MUTEX.name: Live Trading Sanctuary Barrier
AXIOM_2_1_LIVE_SANCTUARY_MUTEX.description: Autonomous self-healing, refactoring, and heavy testing loops must NEVER touch files or consume CPU priority when Bot 1 holds active positions or during T_rem <= 240s.

AXIOM_2_2_PARAMETER_FREEZE.name: Strategy Hyperparameter Freeze
AXIOM_2_2_PARAMETER_FREEZE.description: Self-healing daemons are strictly forbidden from modifying calibrated strategy parameters (discount_limit_price, vpin, velocity sweetspots). Bug fixes only.

AXIOM_2_3_TOKEN_CREDIT_ARMOR.name: Token Bucket Rate Limiting
AXIOM_2_3_TOKEN_CREDIT_ARMOR.description: Lead Deer cloud consultations are hard-capped to <= 2 queries per hour with micro-payloads (<= 60 lines) to guarantee $0.00 cost within Google Free Tier.
